units.source_text: 然而，尽管山峦是黑压压的，但不知为什么看上去却像茫茫的白色。

en.t: Yet although the mountains were dark and heavy, somehow they looked like an endless expanse of white.

units.source_text: 这样一来，令人感到山峦仿佛是透明而冰凉的。

en.t: In that way, the mountains seemed transparent and cold.

units.source_text: 天空和山峦的色调并不协调。

en.t: The tones of the sky and the mountains did not harmonize.
